description_en: Queries the details of a specified upgrade batch
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定升级批次的详情
name: QueryOTAJob

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If the instance has an ID, you must specify this ID. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the instance does not have an <props="intl"><ph>Instance Overview page or an </ph></props>ID, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the upgrade batch.

The JobId returned after you call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147480.html, https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147496.html, or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147887.html to create an upgrade batch. You can also view the ID on the OTA Update Package Details page in the IoT Platform console
parameters.help_zh:
升级批次ID。

您调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147480.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147496.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147887.html创建升级任务批次后，返回的**JobId**。您也可以在物联网平台控制台的**升级包详情**页面查看
parameters.name: job_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_en: The upgrade batch information returned if the call is successful. For more information, see the parameters contained in Data
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的升级批次信息。详情见以下Data所包含的参数

DestVersion.description_en: The destination version number for the upgrade

DownloadProtocol.description_en: The download protocol for the OTA update package file
DownloadProtocol.description_zh: 升级包文件的下载协议

DynamicMode.description_en:
The dynamic upgrade mode. Valid values:

1: In addition to upgrading devices that currently meet the upgrade conditions, the system continuously checks whether devices meet the upgrade conditions and upgrades the devices that meet the conditions.
2: The upgrade takes effect only on devices that subsequently report new version numbers.

This parameter is returned only when the upgrade policy is dynamic upgrade
DynamicMode.description_zh:
动态升级模式。取值范围：

1：除了升级当前满足升级条件的设备，还将持续检查设备是否满足升级条件，对满足升级条件的设备进行升级。
2：仅对后续上报新版本号的设备生效。

仅升级策略为动态升级时，返回该参数

FirmwareId.description_en: The ID of the OTA update package

GrayPercent.description_en:
The percentage of devices for the canary upgrade.

This parameter is returned only when the upgrade scope is canary upgrade
GrayPercent.description_zh:
灰度升级的比例。

仅升级范围为灰度升级时，返回该参数

GroupId.description_en: The ID of the device group for the group upgrade

GroupName.description_en: The name of the device group for the group upgrade
GroupName.description_zh: 分组升级的设备分组名称

JobDesc.description_en: The description of the upgrade batch

JobId.description_en: The ID of the upgrade batch, which is the unique identifier of the batch
JobId.description_zh: 升级批次ID，批次的唯一标识符

JobStatus.description_en:
The status of the batch. Valid values:

PLANNED: planned. The batch is created, but the scheduled time has not arrived. This value may be returned only for scheduled static upgrade batches.
IN_PROGRESS: in progress.
COMPLETED: completed.
CANCELED: canceled
JobStatus.description_zh:
批次的状态。

PLANNED：计划中。批次已创建，但是定时时间未到。仅定时静态升级的批次可能返回该值。
IN_PROGRESS：执行中。
COMPLETED：已完成。
CANCELED：已取消

JobType.description_en:
The batch type. Valid values:

VERIFY_FIRMWARE: OTA update package verification batch.
UPGRADE_FIRMWARE: mass upgrade batch
JobType.description_zh:
批次类型。

VERIFY_FIRMWARE：升级包验证批次。
UPGRADE_FIRMWARE：批量升级批次

MaximumPerMinute.description_en: The maximum number of devices to which the download URL of the OTA update package is pushed per minute
MaximumPerMinute.description_zh: 每分钟最多向多少个设备推送升级包下载URL

MultiModuleMode.description_en:
Indicates whether the device supports simultaneous upgrades of multiple modules. Valid values:

false (default): no. The device does not support simultaneous upgrades of multiple modules.
true: yes. The device supports simultaneous upgrades of multiple modules.

For more information, see [Devices that support simultaneous upgrades of multiple modules]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/58328.html）
MultiModuleMode.description_zh:
设备是否支持多模块同时升级。

false（默认）：否，设备不支持多模块同时升级。
true：是，设备支持多模块同时升级。

更多信息，请参见[设备支持多模块同时升级说明表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/58328.html）

Name.description_en: The name of the OTA update package

NeedConfirm.description_en: Indicates whether the upgrade requires confirmation from the app

NeedPush.description_en: Indicates whether IoT Platform proactively pushes the upgrade task to devices
NeedPush.description_zh: 物联网平台是否主动向设备推送升级任务

OverwriteMode.description_en:
Specifies whether to overwrite the previous upgrade tasks. Valid values:

1: does not overwrite. If a device already has an upgrade task, only the existing task is executed.
2: overwrites. The device executes only the new upgrade task.

Tasks in progress are not overwritten
OverwriteMode.description_zh:
是否覆盖之前的升级任务。取值：

1：不覆盖。若设备已有升级任务，则只执行已有任务。
2：覆盖。设备只执行新的升级任务。

不覆盖升级中的任务

ProductKey.description_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the OTA update package belongs

RetryCount.description_en:
The number of automatic retries after a device upgrade fails.

This parameter is returned if a retry policy is configured when the upgrade batch is created
RetryCount.description_zh:
设备升级失败后，自动重试次数。

创建升级批次时，设置了失败重试策略，则返回该参数

RetryInterval.description_en:
The automatic retry interval after a device upgrade fails. Unit: minutes.

This parameter is returned if a failure retry policy is configured when the upgrade batch is created
RetryInterval.description_zh:
设备升级失败后，自动重试时间间隔，单位：分钟。

创建升级批次时，设置了失败重试策略，则返回该参数

SelectionType.description_en:
The upgrade policy. Valid values:

DYNAMIC: dynamic upgrade. This value is returned for an upgrade batch created by calling [CreateOTADynamicUpgradeJob]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147887.html）.
STATIC: static upgrade. This value is returned for an upgrade batch created by calling [CreateOTAStaticUpgradeJob]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147496.html）
SelectionType.description_zh:
升级策略。

DYNAMIC：动态升级。调用[CreateOTADynamicUpgradeJob]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147887.html）创建的升级批次，该参数返回该值。
STATIC：静态升级。调用[CreateOTAStaticUpgradeJob]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147496.html）创建的升级批次，该参数返回该值

TargetSelection.description_en:
The upgrade scope. Valid values:

ALL: full upgrade.
SPECIFIC: targeted upgrade.
GRAY: canary upgrade.

For a dynamic upgrade batch created by calling [CreateOTADynamicUpgradeJob]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147887.html）, this parameter returns only ALL
TargetSelection.description_zh:
升级范围。

ALL：全量升级。
SPECIFIC：定向升级。
GRAY：灰度升级。

调用[CreateOTADynamicUpgradeJob]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147887.html）创建的动态升级批次，该参数仅返回ALL

TimeoutInMinutes.description_en:
The timeout period for a device upgrade. Unit: minutes.

This parameter is returned if a timeout period is configured when the upgrade batch is created
TimeoutInMinutes.description_zh:
设备升级超时时间，单位：分钟。

创建升级批次时，设置了超时时间，则返回该参数

UtcCreate.description_en: The time when the batch was created. The time is in UTC
UtcCreate.description_zh: 批次创建时的时间，UTC格式

UtcEndTime.description_en:
The time when the execution of the batch task ended. The time is in UTC.

This parameter is returned only for upgrade batches whose execution has ended
UtcEndTime.description_zh:
该批次任务执行结束时的时间，UTC格式。

仅已执行结束的升级批次才返回此参数

UtcModified.description_en: The time when the batch was last modified. The time is in UTC
UtcModified.description_zh: 批次最后一次修改时的时间，UTC格式

UtcScheduleFinishTime.description_en: The end time of the scheduled upgrade. This parameter is returned only for scheduled upgrade tasks for which an end time is configured
UtcScheduleFinishTime.description_zh: 定时升级结束的时间。仅定时升级任务且设置了定时升级结束时间时会返回该参数

UtcScheduleTime.description_en: The time when the scheduled upgrade is initiated. This parameter is returned only for scheduled upgrade tasks
UtcScheduleTime.description_zh: 定时升级发起的时间。仅定时升级任务会返回该参数

UtcStartTime.description_en: The time when the batch task started to be executed. The time is in UTC
UtcStartTime.description_zh: 该批次任务开始执行时的时间，UTC格式

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
